ties.basis: 064-1a-BH-002.krn lines 588/591: source tie continues in another encoded voice of the same staff; LilyPond cannot tie across voices, so the note is held, not reattacked.

bars.description: Pickup bar 0 and bars 1-192 of the written-out first edition once (bar 64 is split 2+1 quarters by an unnumbered double bar). Performed order NOT established; see provenance.

endpoints.basis: WITHHELD (19 Oct 2026): dry run passed numerically, but overlays show bars 160-166 compressed into about 1 s near 161 s and 17 s of performed music after the mapped final chord at 180.6 s; the performed order versus the first-edition text (194 bars, no repeat signs) is unresolved.
